depth_enabled.label: Widget-safe wallpaper depth
depth_enabled.description: Place decorative widgets behind wallpaper foregrounds while keeping interactive cards and legible clocks unobscured.

depth_threshold.label: Foreground threshold
depth_threshold.description: Normalized depth cutoff (0-100). Lower values bring more foreground scenery in front of decorative widgets.

depth_feather.label: Edge feather
depth_feather.description: Soft-transition width around the depth cutoff (0-50).

clock_max_occlusion.label: Clock max occlusion (%)
clock_max_occlusion.description: Maximum fraction of the clock dial allowed behind the foreground before the clock automatically moves in front.
